ex: My cousin works as a roadie for a rock band.
The roadies carry the speakers onto the stage.
Is it hard to be a roadie on a long tour?
A roadie checks every guitar before the concert starts.
roadie.note: A person who travels with a band and sets up its equipment.

ex: He can do a wheelie on his bike for ten seconds.
Please don't do wheelies on the busy street.
My son learned to do a wheelie last summer.
Can you show me how to do a wheelie?
wheelie.note: Usually "do a wheelie": ride on the back wheel only.

ex: The teacher has a one-on-one meeting with each student.
I prefer one-on-one lessons to big group classes.
Can we have a one-on-one talk after work?
He is very good in one-on-one games on the court.
one-on-one.note: Also used as an adverb: "We talked one-on-one."

ex: My sister started the paleo diet last month.
Is this bread okay for paleo, or does it have wheat?
On paleo, you eat meat, fish, vegetables, and nuts.
Many people try paleo to lose weight.
paleo.note: Short for "the paleo diet"; often used like an adjective: "a paleo recipe."

ex: I booked a spa pedicure for Saturday morning.
A spa pedicure usually includes a foot massage.
How much does a spa pedicure cost at this salon?
She got a spa pedicure before her vacation.
He wears preppy clothes like polo shirts and sweaters.
I like her preppy style with a skirt and blazer.
Is this jacket too preppy for a rock concert?
The students at that school look very preppy.
preppy.note: Neat, classic style of clothes, like students at expensive private schools.

ex: Talk to the NPC in the village to get a new quest.
The NPCs in this game look very real.
Which NPC sells better weapons in this town?
You can't attack this NPC because he is friendly.
NPC.note: Non-player character: a character in a game that the computer controls.

ex: Her long dress and big hat are pure boho chic.
I want to decorate my bedroom in boho chic style.
Boho chic is popular at summer music festivals.
Do you think this bag looks boho chic?
Hard enduro races take place on rocks, mud, and steep hills.
You need a light motorcycle for hard enduro.
He has been riding hard enduro for five years.
Is hard enduro too dangerous for beginners?
hard enduro.note: Off-road motorcycle racing on very difficult ground.

ex: I watched a how-to on fixing a leaking faucet.
This website has simple how-tos for home repairs.
Can you send me a how-to for setting up the printer?
She writes how-to articles about cooking.
how-to.note: Often used before a noun: "a how-to video," "a how-to guide."

ex: The hotel charges a fee for no-shows.
There were five no-shows at the dentist today.
If you are a no-show, you will lose your deposit.
Please call us to cancel and avoid being a no-show.
no-show.note: A person who books a place or promises to come but does not come.

ex: I prefer PvP because playing against real people is exciting.
This server has PvP only in some areas.
Do you want to try PvP mode with me tonight?
My character is too weak for PvP right now.
PvP.note: Player versus player: players fight against each other in a game.

ex: He plays an MMO with thousands of other players online.
Which MMO do you recommend for beginners?
In this MMO, you can join a team with friends.
Many MMOs are free, but you can buy extra items.
MMO.note: A massively multiplayer online game; note "an MMO" (not "a MMO").

ex: She collects kawaii stickers with cats and rabbits.
This little pink backpack is so kawaii!
My daughter loves kawaii drawings from Japanese cartoons.
Where can I buy kawaii notebooks for school?
kawaii.note: From Japanese: very cute, often in a childlike style.

ex: Let's get coffee at the drive-through on the way to work.
The drive-through line is very long this morning.
Is the drive-through open after midnight?
Our bank has a drive-through, so you don't need to park.
Our team finished the rogaine in twenty-four hours.
In a rogaine, you use a map to find checkpoints.
Do I need a compass for the rogaine this weekend?
The local club organizes a rogaine every spring.
rogaine.note: A long team race with map and compass. "Rogaine" with a capital R is also a hair medicine brand.

ex: Strobing uses highlighter to make your face look bright.
For strobing, put cream on your cheekbones and nose.
Is strobing easier than contouring for beginners?
She learned strobing from a makeup video online.
strobing.note: Also means fast flashing light: "strobing lights at a party."

ex: The kids made tie-dye T-shirts at summer camp.
I love the bright colors of this tie-dye dress.
Tie-dye was very popular in the 1960s.
Can you show me how to do tie-dye at home?
tie-dye.note: Also a verb: "We tie-dyed our shirts."

ex: I always take a multitool when I go camping.
My multitool has a knife, scissors, and a screwdriver.
Can I bring a multitool in my bag on the plane?
He fixed the bike with his small multitool.
Biohacking includes cold showers, special diets, and sleep tracking.
My friend spends a lot of money on biohacking.
Is biohacking safe, or should I ask a doctor first?
He reads blogs about biohacking to improve his health.
This old castle is a must-see for tourists.
The new science museum is a real must-see.
What are the must-sees in this city?
His latest movie is a must-see for all fans.
must-see.note: More often an adjective: "a must-see movie."

ex: Her new song became a megahit in just one week.
The movie was a megahit all over the world.
Do you remember that summer megahit from 2010?
The band played all their megahits at the concert.
The wedding dress has long sleeves made of white guipure.
Guipure is a heavy lace without a net background.
How much does one meter of this guipure cost?
She sewed guipure on the collar of her blouse.
A cryosauna uses very cold air for about three minutes.
Athletes use a cryosauna to recover after training.
Is the cryosauna safe for people with heart problems?
This fitness club has a cryosauna on the second floor.
The article explains the meaning of the word rashism.
Many Ukrainians call Russian imperial ideology rashism.
Rashism is often compared to fascism.
The museum has an exhibition about the crimes of rashism.
rashism.note: Used mainly about modern Russian aggression; also spelled "ruscism."

ex: The rider did a stoppie on his front wheel.
A stoppie is the opposite of a wheelie.
Don't try a stoppie without a helmet and practice.
Can you do a stoppie on a mountain bike?
stoppie.note: Usually "do a stoppie": brake hard and ride on the front wheel only.
